structured_intermediate_discussion.description: Both reconsideration rounds emit full 24-item JSON; Codex chair emits final JSON.

free_text_intermediate_discussion.description: Only the chair is schema-constrained. Codex and Gemini exchange free-text critique focused on disagreements, evidence, blind spots and uncertainty.

recommendation.reason: It retains the structured protocol's 71.43% recall while reducing false positives from four to three; it has the highest balanced accuracy of the tested modes.
recommendation.tradeoff: Compared with single Codex, it gains one net true positive and raises balanced accuracy by 4.20 percentage points, but requires five model calls and about 3.48 times the critical-path latency.
recommendation.use_case: Use Discussion for high-impact or disputed slices, not every routine batch. For ordinary review, single Codex remains more cost-efficient.
recommendation.safety: Discussion still exhibits opinion propagation and misses source-dependent distinctions. Fixed-source adjudication and deterministic lint remain mandatory.
